summary.text: Jack Codiga is the Republican nominee for North Carolina's 12th Congressional District. A California native who moved to Charlotte in 2021, he works in finance as an associate producer at the mortgage lender Medalist Capital and has not previously held elected office. His campaign website calls for abolishing the Federal Reserve and returning to gold- and silver-backed money.

paragraphs.text: Graduated from Scotts Valley High School and earned a bachelor's degree in finance from Santa Clara University's Leavey School of Business.
Moved to Charlotte from California in 2021, according to WFAE's 2026 voter guide.
Works in finance; WFAE lists his occupation as associate producer at Medalist Capital, a mortgage lender. He describes himself as "a Christian, finance professional, and proud American."
Has no previous experience in elected office, according to WFAE; won the March 3, 2026 Republican primary over Addul Ali with 67.4% of the vote.
